rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (5 tracks) per https://www.discogs.com/Ed-Sheeran-The-Orange-Room-EP/release/7514776, https://eil.com/shop/moreinfo.asp?catalogid=881081. 2005 independent CD EP (Sheeran Lock), the first Ed Sheeran release. 5 tracks confirmed across 5+ independent sources (Discogs release r7514776, MusicBrainz/CritiqueBrainz, eil.com, last.fm, Internet Archive). The claim that it has 7 tracks including 'Move On' and 'I Love You (Reprise)' is NOT supported by any source - those titles do not appear on the physical tracklist; 'Move On' is actually on the 2007 'Want Some?' EP.
